title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：tailor　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tailor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the tailor ① hired the tailor that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the hiring was the whole of the week. The ② tailor, meaning the maker itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a tailor, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ tailor in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ tailor at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tailor, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the tailor said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tailor was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the maker. The ⑥ tailor, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; tailor, he said, is either something you hire or the only word that means both a maker and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ tailor had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ tailor of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of describing; tailor, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tailor I remember is the maker described in the order, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ tailor, my mother said in 1980, is the only maker that improves by being described; every tailor, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a maker. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 裁缝（指裁缝铺里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 裁缝（指那位裁缝本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：hire the tailor 请这一位裁缝
D. n. 裁缝（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 裁缝之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的裁缝之事）
F. n. 裁缝（指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 裁缝、手艺（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 手艺（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: hired the tailor that no customer in the shop would have described
The tailor, meaning the maker itself and not the needle
the tailor at the far mirror
the tailor was the whole of the matter
the tailor had become a line in an order
The tailor of the whole thing
A tailor, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: hire the tailor 意为“请这一位裁缝”，1971 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯描述的一位裁缝做了一遍。
tailor 意为“裁缝”，指那位裁缝本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
tailor 意为“裁缝”，指裁缝铺里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
tailor 意为“裁缝”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tailor 意为“裁缝、手艺”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位手艺就是那件事的全部。
tailor 意为“手艺”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位裁缝，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tailor 意为“裁缝”，指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一位，到 1976 年这一位成了订单簿里的一行。
tailor 意为“裁缝之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的裁缝之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的描述。
tailor 意为“裁缝”，我记得的是订单簿里描述过的那一位，1978 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一位。
tailor 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，裁缝是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的裁缝。
